title: 3 Powerful Bible Verses That Give You Divine Strength 🕊️ #bible #faith #shorts
script_body: When life feels overwhelming, remember Psalm 46 verse 1. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Isaiah chapter 40 verse 31 promises that those who trust in the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings like eagles. Trust His divine timing today.

title: Do Not Fear: God Is Always Working For You ✝️ #bibleverses #catholic #inspiration
script_body: Philippians chapter 4 verse 13 says, I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. No obstacle is too big when God is by your side. Surrender your worries, open your heart to prayer, and let His peace guard your mind.

title: The Secret To Overcoming Anxiety According To Scripture 📖 #faith #christian #god
script_body: First Peter chapter 5 verse 7 instructs us to cast all your anxiety on Him because He cares for you. You do not have to carry the heavy burdens of tomorrow alone. Trust in the Almighty, pray with devotion, and receive His heavenly calm.
